reference_sql:
WITH promo_revenue AS (  -- one row per promotion
  SELECT promo_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_code, ROUND(r.net_revenue_eur / (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1), 2) AS revenue_per_day
FROM promotions p
JOIN promo_revenue r ON r.promo_id = p.promo_id
alternatives: SELECT p.promo_code, ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) / (p.end_date - p.start_date + 1), 2) AS revenue_per_day FROM promotions p JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_code, p.start_date, p.end_date

solver.query:
SELECT p.promo_code,
       ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * CAST(ol.unit_price_eur AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(ol.line_discount_eur AS DECIMAL(18,2)))
             / (CAST(p.end_date AS DATE) - CAST(p.start_date AS DATE) + 1), 2) AS revenue_per_day
FROM promotions p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_code, p.start_date, p.end_date
